summary.name: Manufact (mcp-use)
summary.one_liner: Manufact is a cloud platform for hosting, testing, and publishing production MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and apps, built around the open-source mcp-use SDK.
use_cases: Deploy an MCP server or app to production
Get an MCP app listed in the ChatGPT or Claude plugin stores
Test one MCP release across multiple clients
Debug and replay MCP traffic in production
Expose a local MCP server through a secure tunnel
Monitor MCP usage, latency, and reliability
summary.what_it_does: Manufact provides Manufact Cloud for deploying MCP apps and servers to production. It offers cross-client testing to run the same checks across ChatGPT, Claude, and other clients. Publishing checks audit an MCP app against ChatGPT Apps Store and Cloud Connectors requirements, and a Submission Pack generates assets for marketplace submission. The Cloud Inspector traces, replays, and debugs MCP traffic, and analytics show usage, latency, and reliability. The page also lists the mcp-use SDK, Inspector, client CLI, tunneling, and a Vibe product, plus an MCP Quality Score for ranking servers.
notable: Publishing checks against ChatGPT Apps Store and Cloud Connectors requirements
Cloud Inspector for tracing and replaying MCP traffic in production
Built on the open-source mcp-use SDK (listed as free and open source in the directory listing)
MCP Quality Score for scoring and ranking MCP servers
caveats: Pricing details are not shown on the page; a Pricing link exists but its content was not included
